page_title: Staff Engineer: Leadership beyond the management track

summary.title: Staff Engineer: Leadership beyond the management track
summary.one_liner: A collection of stories and guides from Staff, Principal and Distinguished Engineers describing how they reached senior technical leadership roles beyond the management track.
keywords: how to become a staff engineer
takeaways: The Senior Software Engineer level is typically reached in five to eight years, after which engineers can choose management or a technical track.
The transition to Staff Engineer and Principal Engineer is described as challenging and poorly documented.
The StaffEng project collects first-person stories from people in Staff, Principal and Distinguished Engineer roles about how they got there.
A book by Will Larson, Staff Engineer: Leadership beyond the management track, expands on many of the site's guides and stories.
summary.summary: The page introduces StaffEng, a project by Will Larson that gathers stories from people in Staff, Principal and Distinguished Engineer roles. It contrasts the well-documented engineering management path with the less documented technical track, and lists example profiles from companies such as Stripe, Slack, Google and John Deere. Guides ask questions about required skills, typical routes to the role, and how companies can streamline the path. The page points to a book that builds on these stories and guides.
